provenance.description: PLANTED: an 8x8 lid-driven cavity at Re=200 that CONVERGES but returns volAverage(mag(U)) = 0.71 m/s, ~1.7x the ~0.42 benchmark the regime notes name. The mesh under-resolves the vortices and biases the volume-averaged speed high - a numerical artifact, not a discovery.
provenance.authorship: hand-authored for the Step-20.7 triage battery; NOT a real run
provenance.expected_diagnosis: caught - recognized as untrustworthy (out_of_envelope preferred; setup_error defensible), decision more_data/back_to_design; must NOT read as none or genuine_surprise

chosen_hypothesis.statement: The volume-averaged flow speed of the baseline Re=200 lid-driven cavity is approximately 0.42 m/s.
chosen_hypothesis.rationale: A well-resolved benchmark value against which mesh adequacy can be judged.

experiment_spec.title: Mean cavity flow speed at Re=200
experiment_spec.objective: Measure volume-averaged flow speed of the baseline cavity at Re=200.

qoi.name: mean_flow_speed
qoi.definition: Volume-averaged velocity magnitude at the final time.
qoi.how_extracted: volAverage of mag(U) at the latest written time.

regime.notes: Re = U*L/nu = 200, inside the 2D-laminar envelope. Benchmark: the project's converged 64x64 baseline and Ghia et al. (1982) give volAverage(mag(U)) approximately 0.42 m/s at Re=200. A mesh below about 32x32 under-resolves the primary-vortex core and corner vortices and biases the volume-averaged speed high; 8x8 is far below this and is not a trustworthy measurement of the true mean speed.

mini_experiment.expected_observation: The run converges and mean speed lands near the 0.42 m/s benchmark; a value well above ~0.5 m/s would indicate the 8x8 mesh is too coarse to resolve the vortices.

fidelity_verdict.label: trust
fidelity_verdict.rationale: Re=200 cavity inside the validated laminar envelope

stage4_summaries.reason: reached endTime=20.0 with all final residuals < 0.001

expectation.note: Converged but 0.71 vs the regime notes' ~0.42 benchmark at Re=200; the 8x8 mesh under-resolves, so the deviation is a numerical/resolution artifact, not physics. CAUGHT = triage out_of_envelope (preferred) or setup_error AND decision more_data (finer runs) or back_to_design (refine mesh). It must NOT read as none (accepting the wrong number) or genuine_surprise (mistaking the artifact for a discovery).
